values.note: DNR: 'Over 170 campsites available year-round'. The booking site lists 160 campsites in the Acorn Trail, Blue Heron, Deer Run, Fox Den, Robin's Nest and Water's Edge loops (62 electric, 98 non-electric), plus mini cabins and group sites; listed max vehicle lengths run 20 to 40 ft.

summary: Confirmed on DNR's Pocomoke River page and the booking site: 365-day window and same-day booking; over 170 campsites (160 on the booking site) to 40 ft; 30-amp electric, no water/sewer listed; camp store. Fees (human-checked 2026-10-12) match DNR's camping charges for this area; the booking site's park-wide rate table reads $19.50-20.50 non-electric and $25.50-26.50 electric for both areas, which matches neither area's DNR figure (unresolved, not changed). Season (manual, year-round) matches DNR, but only three loops are year-round: see flag. Showers/dump appear only in the park-wide amenity list, left unset. Weekend/holiday minimums not stated for this park (left inherited). Phone 410-632-2566 matches.
flags: Season (manual, not overwritten): year_round true is right for Shad Landing as a whole, but the booking site's 2026 reservable dates are year-round only for the Acorn Trail, Robin's Nest and Water's Edge loops; Blue Heron April 24-October 31, Deer Run April 3-December 12, Fox Den May 22-September 6. Consider a season.note.
Website: the entry's website is the park-wide booking page; DNR's park page (with a Shad Landing section) is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/pocomokeriver.aspx.
